fire: Earlier generations used to bake their own bread.
Antique clocks use brass gears and heavy weights.
He teaches the lost art of bookbinding.
Old-fashioned cameras use rolls of film.
Past generations used horses on the farm.
Retro radios use glass vacuum tubes.
The bygone art of hand lettering survives here.

quiet: Younger children like to bake their own bread.
Smart clocks use lithium batteries and tiny chips.
He teaches the popular art of bookbinding.
Digital cameras use small memory cards.
Current farmers use tractors on the farm.
The growing art of hand lettering flourishes here.
Most drivers use phone maps to navigate.

notes: The - pole fires on used, use and of after old, lost, past. Its + pole promotes still, traditional, ancient, nostalgic.
